utthita-hasta-padangusthasana.drishti: Padhayoragrai (toes); Parsva (side) in the open variation

steps.m: Shift onto the left leg, hook the right big toe and lift the leg; left hand on the hip
Fold, chin toward the shin
Lift the head
Open the leg out to the right; gaze over the left shoulder
Bring the leg back to center
Fold, chin toward the shin
Lift the head, hands to the hips, hold the leg up unsupported
Lower the leg to Samasthitih
Shift onto the right leg, hook the left big toe and lift the leg
Fold, chin toward the shin
Lift the head
Open the leg out to the left; gaze over the right shoulder
Bring the leg back to center
Fold, chin toward the shin
Lift the head, hands to the hips, hold the leg up unsupported
Lower the leg to Samasthitih

alignment: Keep the standing leg straight and strong and the hips level.
Keep the lifted leg straight before you fold; height comes with time.
Lengthen the spine before folding; the chin travels toward the shin, not the knee.
In the side variation, keep both hips facing forward.
modifications: Bend the lifted knee, or loop a strap around the foot.
Keep the torso upright instead of folding.
Stand beside a wall for balance.

ardha-baddha-padmottanasana.english: Half Bound Lotus Standing Forward Bend

steps.m: Draw the right foot into half lotus; reach the right arm behind and catch the right big toe
Fold, left hand to the floor beside the foot
Lift the head
Come up to standing, still bound
Release the leg to Samasthitih
Draw the left foot into half lotus and bind with the left hand
Fold, right hand to the floor
Lift the head
Come up to standing; exhale release the leg to Samasthitih

alignment: Press the lotus heel into the lower belly with the knee pointing down.
Bind first, then fold. Soften the standing knee if needed.
Keep the shoulders square and draw the chin toward the shin.
modifications: Hold the lotus foot with the opposite hand in front instead of binding.
Place the foot on the inner thigh (tree position) and fold with the hands on blocks.
Never force the knee. Lotus should always be pain-free.

steps.m: Jump forward, bend the knees deeply and raise the arms overhead; gaze at the thumbs

utkatasana.note: In daily practice, flow from Down Dog straight into Virabhadrasana.
alignment: Keep the knees and feet together and the weight in the heels.
Sit back as if into a chair; draw the belly in and lengthen the tailbone.
Arms straight beside the ears, palms together.
modifications: Place the feet hip-width apart.
Keep the arms parallel or the hands on the hips if the shoulders are tight.

virabhadrasana-a.note: Virabhadrasana A and B share one count. In daily practice, flow from Down Dog into the seated postures.

steps.m: Turn the left heel in, step the right foot forward, bend the right knee, arms up
Straighten, turn to the left and bend the left knee
Open the hips and arms to Virabhadrasana B on the left; gaze over the left hand
Turn to the right, Virabhadrasana B on the right

alignment: Front knee over the ankle; back heel down with the foot turned in about 45°.
Square the hips forward and lift the ribs away from the pelvis.
Reach up through the arms with the palms together.
modifications: Shorten the stance.
Hands on the hips or arms shoulder-width apart.

alignment: Front heel lines up with the arch of the back foot; hips open to the side.
Front knee tracks toward the little toe.
Arms level with the floor, shoulders relaxed down.
modifications: Shorten the stance.
Reduce the bend in the front knee.

alignment: Legs together and active, feet flexed.
Palms beside the hips press down as the crown lifts.
Draw the belly in and keep the chest open.
modifications: Sit on a folded blanket.
Bend the knees slightly to keep the spine upright.

paschimottanasana.meaning: Intense stretch of the west (back of the body)
paschimottanasana.note: Grips: A holds the big toes, B the outer edges of the feet, C a wrist beyond the soles. Some teachers add D.

steps.m: Jump or step through to sit in Dandasana
Hold the big toes (A), straighten the arms, lift the chest and look up
Fold forward over the legs, elbows wide
Lift the head and chest
Change the grip (B, then C) and fold again, 5 breaths each, lifting the head between

alignment: Fold from the hips with a long spine. Lead with the belly, not the head.
Keep the legs together and active, feet flexed, kneecaps lifted.
Elbows wide and lifted; shoulders away from the ears.
Breathe into the back body and let the neck release in the fold.
modifications: Sit on a folded blanket to tilt the pelvis forward.
Bend the knees, or hold the shins or a strap.
Stay more upright with a flat back rather than rounding.

purvottanasana.meaning: Intense stretch of the east (front of the body)

steps.m: Jump through to sit; place the hands behind the hips, fingers toward the feet
Press up and lift the hips, toes pointing to the floor; release the head back
Lower to sit

alignment: Hands shoulder-width apart, fingers pointing toward the feet.
Lift the hips level with the shoulders and press the soles toward the floor.
Release the head back only if the neck is comfortable.
modifications: Reverse tabletop: knees bent, feet flat on the floor.
Keep the chin toward the chest.

ardha-baddha-padma-paschimottanasana.english: Half Bound Lotus Seated Forward Bend
ardha-baddha-padma-paschimottanasana.meaning: Half bound lotus intense west stretch

steps.m: Jump through; take the right foot into half lotus, reach the right hand behind and catch the big toe; the left hand holds the left foot; look up
Fold forward
Lift the head
Jump through; left foot into half lotus, bind with the left hand, hold the right foot; look up
Fold forward
Lift the head

alignment: Press the lotus heel into the lower belly; draw the knee toward the straight leg.
Bind before you fold and keep the shoulders square.
Keep the extended leg active, foot flexed.
modifications: Place the foot against the inner thigh (no lotus) and hold the extended foot with both hands.
Skip the bind and hold the extended foot with both hands.
Protect the knee. Never force lotus.

steps.m: Jump through; fold the right leg back beside the right hip; hold the left foot with both hands; look up
Fold forward
Lift the head
Jump through; fold the left leg back; hold the right foot; look up
Fold forward
Lift the head

alignment: Keep both sit bones grounded by leaning slightly toward the bent-leg side.
Knees touch; the folded foot points straight back.
Lengthen the spine before you fold.
modifications: Place a block or blanket under the straight-leg hip.
Hold the shin or use a strap.

steps.m: Jump through; bend the right knee, heel to the inner groin, knee out at about 90°; hold the left foot and look up
Fold over the straight leg
Lift the head
Jump through; bend the left knee and hold the right foot; look up
Fold over the straight leg
Lift the head

alignment: Open the bent knee to about 90° with the heel at the perineum.
Turn the chest to face the straight leg before folding.
Keep the straight leg active and the foot flexed.
modifications: Place a blanket under the bent knee.
Loop a strap around the extended foot.

steps.m: Jump through; bend the right knee to about 85° and sit on the heel, sole facing up; hold the left foot and look up
Fold over the straight leg
Lift the head
Jump through; sit on the left heel and hold the right foot; look up
Fold over the straight leg
Lift the head

alignment: Sit with the perineum on the heel.
Keep the knee angle slightly less than 90°.
Lift up through the spine before folding.
modifications: Practice the A variation instead.
Place a blanket under the bent knee.

steps.m: Jump through; holding the right foot, rotate the shin and place the toes on the floor with the heel against the lower belly; lower the knee forward to about 45°; look up
Fold over the straight leg
Lift the head
Jump through; set up the left leg the same way; look up
Fold over the straight leg
Lift the head

alignment: Move slowly and rotate from the hip, never the knee.
Heel against the navel, toes tucked under, pointing forward.
Lower the knee gradually over many practices.
modifications: Repeat the A variation if there is any knee discomfort.
Support the bent knee with a blanket.

marichyasana-a.meaning: Posture dedicated to the sage Marichi

steps.m: Jump through; bend the right knee with the foot near the sit bone; wrap the right arm around the shin and bind behind the back; look up
Fold over the straight leg
Lift the head
Jump through; bend the left knee, wrap and bind; look up
Fold over the straight leg
Lift the head

alignment: Place the bent-knee foot in line with the hip, a hand's width from the straight thigh.
Reach forward past the shin before wrapping the arm.
Keep the straight leg neutral with the foot flexed.
modifications: Use a strap between the hands.
Hold the shin without binding.

marichyasana-b.meaning: Posture dedicated to the sage Marichi

steps.m: Jump through; take the left foot into half lotus, bend the right knee, wrap the right arm and bind; look up
Fold forward
Lift the head
Jump through; right foot into half lotus, bend the left knee, wrap and bind; look up
Fold forward
Lift the head

alignment: Let the lotus knee ground before you fold.
Sink the weight forward onto the lotus knee.
Keep the bent knee upright, not drifting out.
modifications: Keep the lotus leg straight on the floor.
Hold the hands without binding.

marichyasana-c.meaning: Posture dedicated to the sage Marichi

steps.m: Jump through; bend the right knee, twist to the right, wrap the left arm around the knee and bind behind the back
Jump through; bend the left knee, twist to the left and bind

alignment: Lengthen up on each inhale and twist a little deeper on each exhale.
Keep the straight leg active with the foot flexed.
Keep the bent knee upright and the sit bones grounded.
modifications: Hug the knee with the elbow instead of binding.
Sit on a blanket.

marichyasana-d.meaning: Posture dedicated to the sage Marichi

steps.m: Jump through; take the left foot into half lotus, bend the right knee, twist to the right and bind
Jump through; right foot into half lotus, bend the left knee, twist left and bind

alignment: Set up the half lotus first, then bend the other knee.
Twist from the belly, keeping the spine tall.
Let the lotus knee rest on the floor.
modifications: Practice the twist with the lotus leg extended straight (like Marichyasana C).
Never force lotus.

steps.m: Jump through; lift the straight legs and balance on the sit bones, arms reaching forward
Cross the legs, press the hands down and lift the body; lower and return to Navasana. Five rounds in total.

alignment: Lift through the chest; don't round the lower back.
Keep the legs straight with the toes at eye level.
Arms parallel to the floor, palms facing in.
modifications: Bend the knees (half boat).
Hold the backs of the thighs.
Lift up with the feet staying on the floor.

steps.m: Jump the legs around the arms and cross the ankles, right over left; balance on the hands
Lower the chin (or crown) toward the floor between the hands
Lift the head, release the feet and straighten the legs forward (Tittibhasana)

alignment: Place the thighs high on the upper arms.
Keep the elbows over the wrists.
Squeeze the legs onto the arms and keep the gaze forward.
modifications: Practice from a squat.
Keep the feet on the floor.
Rest the forehead on a block.

kurmasana.note: Kurmasana and Supta Kurmasana share one count.

steps.m: Jump the legs around the arms; lower to sit and slide the arms under the knees, chest down, legs straight
Bend the knees, clasp the hands behind the back and cross the ankles
Release the hands; lift up into Dvi Pada Sirsasana (ankles crossed behind the head) on the hands
Straighten the legs into Tittibhasana

alignment: Lift the heels and press the legs straight.
Reach the arms back under the knees, palms down.
Lengthen through the chest rather than rounding.
modifications: Bend the knees.
Place a block under the chest.
Skip Supta Kurmasana until Kurmasana is comfortable.

alignment: Draw the shoulders under the knees before reaching back.
Cross the ankles behind the head only with a teacher's guidance.
Breathe slowly and let the neck release.
modifications: Hold the hands under the legs without binding.
Keep the feet on the floor.

garbha-pindasana.note: Garbha Pindasana and Kukkutasana share one count.

steps.m: Jump through to Padmasana; thread the arms through the legs up to the elbows
Hold the face, balance; then roll back and forth nine times, circling clockwise
Roll up and balance on the hands in Kukkutasana

alignment: A tight lotus makes threading the arms easier. A little water on the arms helps.
Round the spine to roll smoothly.
Keep the head tucked as you roll back.
modifications: Rock in a cross-legged position.
Hold the shins without threading the arms.
Skip lotus if the knees hurt.

alignment: Arms straight, fingers spread wide.
Lift the lotus away from the floor with strong bandhas.
modifications: Place the hands on blocks.
Keep the toes on the floor.

baddha-konasana.note: A: fold with a long spine. B: round forward, head toward the feet.

steps.m: Jump through; bring the soles together, open the feet like a book, lift the chest and look up
Fold forward, chin toward the floor (A)
Lift the head
Round forward, head toward the feet (B), 5 breaths; inhale up

alignment: Draw the heels close to the groin.
Lead with the chest in A; round the back in B.
Let the knees release down; press gently with the elbows.
modifications: Sit on a blanket.
Move the heels further from the body.

steps.m: Jump through; open the legs wide, hold the outer edges of the feet and look up
Fold forward, chest and chin toward the floor (A)
Come up and lift the legs, balancing on the sit bones while holding the feet (B)

alignment: Keep the knees and toes pointing up.
Fold from the hips with a long spine.
In B, lift the chest and look up.
modifications: Hold the shins or knees.
Practice B with bent knees.

steps.m: Jump through; exhale and lie down on the back
Lift the legs over the head, wide apart, toes to the floor; hold the big toes
Roll up to balance on the sit bones; exhale and land the calves softly, chest toward the floor
Lift the head

alignment: Keep the weight on the shoulders and the neck free.
Point the toes as you roll up.
Land on the calves, not the heels.
modifications: Practice Halasana instead.
Bend the knees to roll up.

supta-padangusthasana.drishti: Padhayoragrai (toes); Parsva (side) in the open variation
supta-padangusthasana.note: The side variation is sometimes called Supta Parsvasahita.

steps.m: Jump through; exhale and lie down
Lift the right leg and hook the big toe; left hand on the left thigh
Lift the chest, chin toward the shin
Head down
Open the leg to the right; gaze left
Bring the leg back to center
Chin toward the shin
Head down; exhale lower the leg
Lift the left leg and hook the big toe
Lift the chest, chin toward the shin
Head down
Open the leg to the left; gaze right
Bring the leg back to center
Chin toward the shin
Head down
Lower the leg

alignment: Keep the bottom leg active and pressing into the floor.
In the side variation, keep both shoulders on the floor.
Lift the leg straight before drawing it closer.
modifications: Loop a strap around the foot.
Bend the lower knee with the foot on the floor.

steps.m: Jump through; exhale and lie down
Lift the legs over the head, toes to the floor; hold both big toes
Roll up to balance on the sit bones with straight legs

alignment: Roll up with momentum, keeping the legs straight.
Lift the chest and draw the shoulders back.
Balance just behind the sit bones.
modifications: Bend the knees to roll up, then straighten.
Hold the shins.

steps.m: Jump through; exhale and lie down
Lift the legs over the head; hold the outer edges of the feet
Roll up to balance, legs straight
Draw the legs toward the face, chin toward the shins

alignment: Lengthen the spine and draw the belly in.
Balance just behind the sit bones.
modifications: Bend the knees.
Hold the shins.

steps.m: Jump through; exhale and lie down with the heels together and toes turned out
Arch the back and place the crown of the head on the floor; cross the arms over the chest
Press through the feet and lift the hips, rolling toward the forehead

alignment: Heels together, toes turned out wide.
Press into the feet, not the head.
Move slowly. Neck strength builds over time.
modifications: Keep the hands on the floor beside the body.
Practice a supported bridge with the shoulders down.
Skip with a neck injury.
